assessment.nobel_worthiness: Showing that liquid-liquid phase separation organizes cytoplasm and nucleoplasm (P granules, nucleoli) is a genuinely new organizing principle for cell chemistry, with a physical-chemistry core (condensate thermodynamics, multivalency, material properties) and wide consequences for disease biology.
assessment.attribution: Hyman and Brangwynne made the founding P-granule and nucleolus observations (2009 onward); Rosen supplied the multivalent-interaction quantitative framework. Pappu and Mittag are strong on theory of sequence grammar, so the three-person cut is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Concept confirmed by many independent groups, but the extent to which in-vivo structures are true phase-separated liquids versus other assemblies is still debated, and quantitative links to function are uneven. Timely rather than premature given how much it has already changed the field.
uncertainties: Debate on whether many cellular condensates are equilibrium phase separation
Choice among Hyman, Brangwynne, Rosen, Pappu, Mittag is not clean
Fit to chemistry rather than medicine or biology

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced proximity degradation is a real game-changer: it turns binding into elimination of the target protein and reaches targets that are undruggable by inhibition. Clinical-stage PROTACs and the molecular glue mechanism of thalidomide analogues are already producing consequences.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies launched the PROTAC concept (Sakamoto 2001), and Ciulli made the key VHL-ligand and structural-mechanism contributions that made it drug-like. Handa and Ito identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, which is a separate molecular-glue strand that may need different recognition. Credit is spread over more than three people.
assessment.maturity: Strong chemistry and multiple independent clinical programs. Approval of a PROTAC drug would strengthen the case, so timing may be slightly early, but the mechanistic basis is firmly established.
uncertainties: No fully approved PROTAC drug yet as far as I know; I have not verified current trial status
Allocation between PROTAC and molecular glue strands is unresolved
Whether Crews, Deshaies and Ciulli is the fairest trio versus Handa

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Machine-learned potentials give near-quantum accuracy at force-field cost and have changed what can be simulated in materials, water, catalysis and reactive chemistry. From my own field, this is a method that connects quantitatively to experiment and is widely used.
assessment.attribution: Behler and Parrinello's 2007 neural network potential is the clear origin; Csányi and Bartók's Gaussian approximation potentials are the other independent foundation. Von Lilienfeld and Weinan E are important but later or adjacent, so the three-laureate cut is defensible.
assessment.maturity: Adoption is broad and accelerating, but universal foundation models and reliability beyond training domains are still evolving. Recognition is plausible but could be slightly early given the rapid pace and the 2024 prize in computational structure prediction.
uncertainties: Generalization and extrapolation limits are not settled
Parrinello's other work (metadynamics, Car-Parrinello) might be considered instead
Contested priority among Behler-Parrinello, Csányi and later groups

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing changed biology and medicine on an enormous scale and rests on elegant chemistry (reversible terminator nucleotides, clustered amplification on surfaces). Clear game-changer with decades of consequences.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman founded the Solexa chemistry and single-molecule approach; Mayer (clonal colony amplification) and Rothberg (454 pyrosequencing) are the other main claimants. This is a real attribution problem under a three-person limit, and fame should not decide it.
assessment.maturity: Technology is fully mature with extensive independent validation. Recognition is long overdue in impact terms, though the chemistry-versus-technology and medicine-versus-chemistry boundary needs care.
uncertainties: Priority among Solexa, 454 and Mayer/Farinelli lines is contested
Sanger sequencing was recognised in 1980, so some may see this as incremental
Which three to name; my selection of Mayer over Rothberg is uncertain

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite solar cells went from a few percent to over 25 percent efficiency in little more than a decade, a remarkable materials development with major energy relevance and a vast research community.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka reported the first perovskite-sensitized cell (2009); Park's solid-state cell (2012) and Snaith's mesoscopic and planar devices were decisive. Grätzel, Seok and Kanatzidis also made significant contributions, so the three-person limit leaves out important people.
assessment.maturity: Independent confirmation of efficiencies is excellent, but long-term stability, lead toxicity and commercial deployment remain unproven, so a case can be made that it is a bit premature compared with proven impact.
uncertainties: Device stability and manufacturability at scale are unresolved
Credit among Miyasaka, Park, Snaith, Grätzel, Seok and Kanatzidis is contested
Fit to chemistry versus physics

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Site-specific incorporation of unnatural amino acids through orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs and reprogrammed codons is new chemistry inside living cells, and it is widely used for probes, crosslinkers and therapeutics.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the first orthogonal pairs and in vivo incorporation in E. coli and yeast; Wang was the lead on early work; Chin extended to quadruplet codons, orthogonal ribosomes and whole-genome recoding. Yokoyama and Mehl made related contributions.
assessment.maturity: Mature and independently reproduced in many labs; applications to medicines are growing. Timing is reasonable, but it has been a candidate for a long time without a decisive new milestone.
uncertainties: Priority among Schultz, Wang and Chin is not fully resolved
Scale of practical impact beyond research tools is moderate
Overlap with prior prizes on directed evolution and chemical biology

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The funnel energy-landscape view resolved the Levinthal paradox and provided a quantitative framework for folding, tied to experimental phi-value analysis; it is theory that actually meets experiment, which I value.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes and Onuchic with Bryngelson developed the theory, Fersht made the experimental mapping of transition states. Dill, Onuchic and others also contributed to the physical picture, so the credit set is broad.
assessment.maturity: The conceptual picture is well established and confirmed by experiments and simulations, but it is now a foundational concept and the recent prize for structure prediction partly overlaps in topic. Recognition is mature, not premature.
uncertainties: Relationship to the 2024 structure-prediction prize
Credit between the theory and the experimental strands
Whether the idea is regarded as a game-changer today or as established background

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Palladium-catalysed C-N coupling is used constantly in pharmaceutical and materials synthesis and made aryl amine construction simple and general, which fits the notion of a straightforward route that changed practice.
assessment.attribution: Buchwald and Hartwig independently developed the general and highly active catalyst systems; Kosugi's tin-amide work and Migita's earlier chemistry are precursors. Two laureates is a clean configuration but the 2010 cross-coupling prize may weigh against it.
assessment.maturity: Highly mature and extensively validated for decades; recognition is certainly not premature, though novelty relative to the 2010 prize will be debated.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2010 Nobel Prize for cross-coupling
Role of Kosugi as precursor
Whether committee sees it as sufficiently distinct
